title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 73 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 73)

content.overview: Former section 73 — Settlement agreement belonged to the detailed conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. That detailed regime was superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical and transition reference and must not be presented as current general conciliation law.
